name: performance-checker
description: A web page performance checker that mixes Lighthouse-style audits, Core Web Vitals, network analysis and PageSpeed Insights into a single report.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/cli && npm run build --workspace=packages/server
scripts.server: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run dev --workspace=packages/server
